'''Bazak's Gang''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that operated in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. Led by [[Lekk Bazak]], the group was a collection of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] and [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. They operated a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]], the ''[[NightRunner]]'', and two [[GAT-12j]] Skipray Blastboats, ''[[Slasher]]'' and [[Slicer (GAT-12j Skipray Blastboat)|''Slicer'']]. Bazak's Gang was allied with the [[Nalmar Family|Nalmar crime family]].<ref name="FBS" />
